A '''pilot''' flew for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point, the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] was on patrol in a [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighter]], along with [[Hootkins (rebel pilot)|Hootkins]]. The two Rebel pilots did not detect anything on their patrol route and were preparing to return to base when the pilot detected some unusual readings on his [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter's]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. Hootkins, however, did not initially detect anything and the two pilots were closing their B-wings' [[S-foils/Legends|S-foils]] when they came under attack. Both starfighters were destroyed.

==Behind the scenes==
The pilot made his only appearance in a tech demo for the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault II: The Hidden Empire]]''. The short video was originally created as a test of video production and compression technology, but was distributed as a trailer for the game with other LucasArts titles. It was also included with ''Rebel Assault II'' itself as an alternative opening video, accessible by holding down the 'B', 'O', and 'T' keys while selecting "Continue Intro" from the game's menu.

[[File:ROTJ_Y-wing_helmet_5_SW_Costumes.jpg|thumb|right|210px|Y-wing pilot helmet from ''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'' reused for the pilot]]
The character was played by [[Marc Bauman]], who returned in the full game as the [[Unidentified captain (Corellia Star)|captain]] of the ''[[Corellia Star]]''.<ref>{{LucasArts|url=products/rebel2/reb_eggs.htm|text=''Rebel Assault II'' - Easter Eggs}}</ref> Given the mysterious nature of the sensor readings, it is likely that the two B-wings were attacked by [[TIE/ph "Phantom" Multi-Role Stealth Starfighter/Legends|TIE/ph phantom]] starfighters equipped with [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking devices]]. However, the attackers are not shown in the video.

Props and costumes created for the [[original trilogy]] of ''[[Star Wars]]'' movies were used during the filming of ''Rebel Assault II''.<ref name="LAV">{{LucasArts|url=products/rebel2/reb_vid.htm|text=''Rebel Assault II'' - Live Action Video}}</ref> The [[Flight helmet/Legends|flight helmet]] worn by the B-wing pilot was one originally created for a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] pilot in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]<ref name="SWC">''[[Star Wars Costumes: The Original Trilogy]]''</ref>, and also was worn by [[Till]] in the full version of the video game.
